cards.example_en: A short introduction explains who the characters are.
cards.example_zh: 一段简短的介绍说明了这些人物是谁。

cards.example_en: The telephone was a great invention.
cards.example_zh: 电话是一项伟大的发明。

cards.example_en: The police will investigate the accident.
cards.example_zh: 警方将调查这起事故。

cards.example_en: Their investment in the bakery paid off within a year.
cards.example_zh: 他们对面包店的投资在一年内有了回报。

cards.example_en: The project will involve three classes.
cards.example_zh: 这个项目将涉及三个班级。

cards.example_en: The old mill gate was made of rusty iron.
cards.example_zh: 磨坊的旧大门是用生锈的铁做成的。

cards.example_en: Litter has become an issue around the bus station.
cards.example_zh: 垃圾已经成了公交车站一带的问题。

cards.example_en: One item on the list was sold out by noon.
cards.example_zh: 清单上有一项到中午就卖光了。

cards.example_en: She spread jam on the toast.
cards.example_zh: 她在吐司上抹了果酱。

cards.example_en: He rubbed his sore jaw.
cards.example_zh: 他揉了揉酸痛的下巴。

cards.example_en: The band plays jazz on Friday nights.
cards.example_zh: 乐队周五晚上演奏爵士乐。

cards.example_en: The two classes made a joint poster for Sports Day.
cards.example_zh: 两个班为运动会做了一张共同的海报。

cards.example_en: She filled her journal with notes about yesterday's storm.
cards.example_zh: 她在日志里记下了昨天的暴风雨。

cards.example_en: She works as a journalist for a newspaper.
cards.example_zh: 她是一家报纸的记者。

cards.example_en: Rare birds live in the jungle.
cards.example_zh: 珍稀鸟类生活在丛林里。

cards.example_en: The judge's decision brought justice for the injured driver.
cards.example_zh: 法官的判决为受伤的司机带来了正义。

cards.example_en: He tried to justify the broken window to his dad.
cards.example_zh: 他试图为打碎的窗户向爸爸辩解。

cards.example_en: A kangaroo jumped across the road.
cards.example_zh: 一只袋鼠跳过了马路。

cards.example_en: The kettle sang on the stove while toast browned.
cards.example_zh: 面包烤黄的时候，水壶在炉子上响了起来。

cards.example_en: My sister is in kindergarten.
cards.example_zh: 我妹妹在上幼儿园。

cards.example_en: The story happens in a small kingdom.
cards.example_zh: 故事发生在一个小王国。

cards.example_en: Dad used a repair kit from the boot to fix the flat tyre.
cards.example_zh: 爸爸用后备箱里的成套工具修好了瘪胎。

cards.example_en: Check the label on the bottle before you take any medicine.
cards.example_zh: 吃药之前，先看一看瓶子上的标签。

cards.example_en: Farm labour starts early when the rice is ready to cut.
cards.example_zh: 稻子可以收割时，田间劳动一大早就开始了。

cards.example_en: I know that the problem is that some students lack practice opportunities.
cards.example_zh: 我知道问题是有些学生缺少练习的机会。

cards.example_en: The lamb stayed close to its mother.
cards.example_zh: 羊羔紧紧跟着母亲。

cards.example_en: She ran one more lap around the track.
cards.example_zh: 她又绕跑道跑了一圈。

cards.example_en: The reading club will launch a book week in March.
cards.example_zh: 阅读社团将在三月发起读书周。

cards.example_en: The group leader checked that everyone had a torch.
cards.example_zh: 组长检查了每个人是否都带了手电筒。

cards.example_en: Her leadership kept the team calm during the close final.
cards.example_zh: 比分接近的决赛里，她的领导让全队保持冷静。

cards.example_en: Our school joined a football league with four nearby towns.
cards.example_zh: 我们学校和附近四个城镇一起参加了足球联盟。

cards.example_en: The roof will leak in heavy rain.
cards.example_zh: 下大雨时屋顶会漏。

cards.example_en: The bag is made of leather.
cards.example_zh: 这个包是皮的。

cards.example_en: I went to a lecture on space travel.
cards.example_zh: 我参加了一个关于太空旅行的讲座。

cards.example_en: A driving licence is the legal proof that you may drive.
cards.example_zh: 驾驶证是你可以开车的合法证明。

cards.example_en: She spends her leisure reading novels in the garden.
cards.example_zh: 她有空的时候就在花园里看小说。

cards.example_en: The length of the pool is marked on the wall tiles.
cards.example_zh: 泳池的长度标在墙面的瓷砖上。

cards.example_en: The museum tells the story of liberation.
cards.example_zh: 博物馆讲述解放的故事。

cards.example_en: They fought for liberty.
cards.example_zh: 他们为自由而奋斗。

cards.example_en: The librarian helped me find the book.
cards.example_zh: 图书管理员帮我找到了那本书。

cards.example_en: The restaurant lost its license after the health inspection.
cards.example_zh: 卫生检查之后，这家餐馆的执照被吊销了。

cards.example_en: Limit phone time so you can finish tonight's homework.
cards.example_zh: 限制玩手机的时间，这样才能做完今晚的作业。

cards.example_en: Time is limited, so start now.
cards.example_zh: 时间有限，现在就开始。

cards.example_en: Click the link on the school site to see the bus times.
cards.example_zh: 点击学校网站上的链接，就能看到校车时间。

cards.example_en: Water is a liquid.
cards.example_zh: 水是液体。

cards.example_en: I literally ran to school.
cards.example_zh: 我真的是跑着去学校的。

cards.example_en: She won a literary prize.
cards.example_zh: 她获得了一个文学奖。

cards.example_en: City living can be noisy, but the shops stay open late.
cards.example_zh: 城市生活可能很吵，但商店会开到很晚。

cards.example_en: Load the suitcases into the car before we leave.
cards.example_zh: 出发前把行李箱装进汽车里。

cards.example_en: They repaid the loan early after selling the old flat.
cards.example_zh: 卖掉旧公寓以后，他们提前还清了贷款。

word.example_en: A lack of sleep hurts attention.
word.example_zh: 缺乏睡眠会伤害注意力。

word.example_en: She explained the chart at length.
word.example_zh: 她详尽地解释了这张图。

word.example_en: He can make a living by teaching music.
